## Set Configs
**Raw data & the data dictionary must be in the config.original_data folder before running**
Raw data (config.csv_list) & data dictionary (config.data_dict) config.raw_data_dirs

```{python}
#| label: Imports and Config
from scn_redcap_clean import Cleaner, config, days, months, years # local import

# Original Data Folder(s) (files can be in subfolders of these folders too)
original_data_folder = ['cleaning_dump']

# Data Dictionary
config.data_dict = 'ToyDict.csv'

# Module Specific
config.modules = ['toy',] # as listed in the Data Dictionary 'Form Name' column

config.csv_list = ['Toy1', 'Toy2.csv']  # raw data csvs for merge

# csv must have all columns of the module(s) you are filtering by (extra modules/cols are fine)
config.raw_module_csv = 'Toy1'

config.med_text_cols = ['toy_meds', 'toy_supps']

config.c_genomic = 'genomic_text1'
config.p_genomic = 'genomic_p._text2'

# all columns marked text in the data dictionary you don't want translated
config.no_translate_cols = [
      config.c_genomic, config.p_genomic, config.birthdate, config.merge_on_id_column]

age_units = [days, months, years]

include_age_groups = True
# age group bins (always starts at 0)
age_groups = {
    days: [
        (7, '0-7 days'),
        (28, '8-28 days'),
        (90, '29-90 days'),
        (180, '3-5 months'),
        (270, '6-8 months'),
        (365, '9-12 months'),
        (float('inf'), '1+ years')],
    months: [
        (1, '0-1 month'),
        (3, '1-3 months'),
        (6, '4-6 months'),
        (9, '7-8 months'),
        (12, '9-11 months'),
        (24, '12-23 months'),
        (36, '24-35 months'),
        (72, '3-5 years'),
        (float('inf'), '5+ years')],
    years: [
        (1, '< 1'),
        (3, '1-2'),
        (5, '3-4'),
        (12, '5-11'),
        (18, '12-17'),
        (25, '18-24'),
        (35, '25-34'),
        (45, '35-44'),
        (55, '45-54'),
        (65, '55-64'),
        (float('inf'), '65+')]
}

cleaner = Cleaner()
```


```{python}
#| label: clean

config.translation_dict = { # !!! planning to track this in notes eventually for each version
            '布洛芬':'Ibuprofen',
            'SCN8A':'SCN8A',
           }

cleaner.proceed.use_existing_overrides = True
cleaner.clean()
```

### If clean() or proceed() outputs a translations_for_review
Add comments to the translations_manual_overrides.txt as needed.
```{python}
#| label: proceed from translated override
cleaner.proceed.translated()
```

### if clean() or proceed() outputs a duplicates_for_review
Add comments to the duplicates_manual_overrides.txt as needed.
*For manual overrides Participant_id should be written as {last Participant_id per bday}.999*
```{python}
#| label: proceed from duplicates override
config.run_clinical = True
cleaner.proceed.duplicates()

```

### if clean() or proceed()  outputs a medications_for_review and/or genomics_for_review
Add comments to the medications_manual_overrides.txt and genomics_manual_overrides.txt as needed.
```{python}
#| label: proceed from clinical overrides
cleaner.proceed.clinical()

```





```{python}
#| label: Extra: do not use existing overrides

# initiate with 
cleaner = Cleaner(use_existing_overrides = False)

# or to change in the middle of cleaning
cleaner.proceed.use_existing_overrides = False

```
